scripts.build: pnpm docs:build && node scripts/check-demo-markdown.mjs && node scripts/agent-docs.mjs && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' exec publint
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @lupinum/board-core build && pnpm --filter @lupinum/board-history --filter @lupinum/vue-board -r build && pnpm --filter @lupinum/board-connections build && pnpm --filter @lupinum/nuxt-board build
scripts.lint: prettier . --check && node scripts/check-docs-theme.mjs && pnpm --filter docs lint && pnpm --filter @lupinum/nuxt-board lint && node scripts/lint-changesets.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter docs typecheck && pnpm --filter @lupinum/nuxt-board test:types
scripts.test: vitest run --exclude packages/nuxt-board/test/basic.test.ts --exclude packages/nuxt-board/test/prefixed.test.ts && pnpm --filter @lupinum/nuxt-board test
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:packed && node scripts/audit-deps.mjs
